text:
maya: Heads-up: APAC launch this Wed — need final pass on homepage + hosted/dedicated/private landing copy before comms.
liam: On it. Is the focus 'predictable latency' or 'private deployments for regulated customers' for APAC?
tara: Both, but hero should be 'Predictable inference across hosted, dedicated, and private' — want one-liner that's local-friendly (call out low-latency regions).
alex: I can write hero variants. Propose 3: latency-led, compliance-led, cost-led. I'll drop PR by EOD. :sparkles:
liam: Also need a short benchmark blurb for the page. Draft idea: "median p99 < 80ms on hosted in ap-northeast-1" — is that OK to publish?
maya: Avoid unverified hard numbers unless research signs off. Suggest 'industry-leading p99 latency in APAC' with a link to the benchmarks page. We'll add a footnote for the detailed report.
campaign-bot: Reminder: webinar signup CTA must map to APAC nurture list. Use hidden form field: <input type="hidden" name="route" value="apac_webinar"> and set route=apac_webinar in inbound mapping.
tara: Good call. I'll add the hidden field + UTM variants. Also drafting the Dedicated blurb: 'Reserved GPU capacity for predictable throughput — deploy in your VPC' (keeping it <100 chars).
liam: For Private pages, recommend 'Region-isolated deployments with enterprise SLAs' + a Contact Sales modal. If content gated, ensure form routes to enterprise queue and include checklist PDF.
maya: :thumbsup: Plan: ship PR with three hero variants, one benchmark line (no hard numbers), and CTA mapping. Target final review Monday morning APAC (Tue UTC). I'll loop ops for the Dedicated sales flow attachments.
tara: Will do. PR link once ready.
